published_estimates.statement: "as of 20 May 2026, approximately 400 to 900 cases of BVD may have occurred in the Democratic Republic of the Congo" ... "with values of over 1000 not being able to be excluded given current data"
published_estimates.citation: McCabe R, et al. Estimation of the size of the outbreak of Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 20 May 2026 update. MRC Centre for Global Infectious Disease Analysis, Imperial College London.

serial_interval.source: WHO Ebola Response Team, NEJM 2014;371:1481-95 (EVD): mean 15.3 days, SD 9.3; WHO ERT 2015 reported 14.2 days

onset_to_death.source: Modelling assumption informed by EVD literature; replace with outbreak-specific estimates when line-list summaries are published

onset_to_report.source: Modelling assumption; estimated from onset-dated data when such data are available

death_ascertainment.source: Modelling assumption. Deaths are generally better ascertained than cases, but community deaths without testing are common in insecure areas.

ifr_symptomatic.source: Assumption bracketing the historical reported-case CFR range and allowing for under-detection of milder illness

cfr_reported.source: WHO Disease Outbreak News 2026-DON602: case fatality rates in the past two BVD outbreaks ranged from 30% to 50%
